items.source: Customize the variables to be set as well-known FreeMarker objects.
items.translation: 自定义variables以将其设置为知名的 FreeMarker 对象。

items.source: Callback interface that can be implemented by beans wishing to customize the FreeMarker shared variables to fine-tune their auto-configuration before they are used by an auto-configured FreeMarkerConfigurationFactory.
items.translation: 可被希望自定义 FreeMarkershared variables 以在自动配置的FreeMarkerConfigurationFactory使用它们之前微调其自动配置的 Bean 实现的回调接口。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
